<context_for_action>
The apt-get install in Step 6 timed out during package downloads (reached 118/119 packages) and did not install any packages successfully. gcc, make, and gcov remain unavailable.

The memory bank suggests two approaches to try:
1. Complete the interrupted apt-get install with a longer timeout (more than 180s)
2. Use a minimal installation: "apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc make" with a longer timeout to reduce the package count and download time

The full "build-essential gcc make tcl" installation was downloading 103 MB across 119 packages when it timed out. A minimal approach focusing only on gcc and make (without build-essential's extra dependencies and without tcl) should be faster.
</context_for_action>
